svg.title: A quadratic family: two real roots, a double root, and no real roots
svg.desc: Three panels use identical axes. The parabola y equals x minus one squared is intersected by the horizontal line y equals one minus lambda. For lambda zero, intersections at x zero and two give two real roots. For lambda one, the line touches the vertex at x one, giving a double root. For lambda two, the line is below the parabola and there are no real intersections.
